entities.name: Shaper Tuvasa
entities.description: Great Shaper of the River Heralds on Ixalan, called the Sunlit; she felt a strong affinity for Ixalan's sun and died in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Group on Ixalan led by Great Shapers, of which Tuvasa was one.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where the River Heralds live.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Tuvasa lost her life.

entities.name: Tuvasa's apprentice
entities.description: Apprentice of Tuvasa who inherited her name and position.

events.summary: Tuvasa dies during the New Phyrexian Invasion and her apprentice inherits her name and position.
events.quote: She lost her life during the New Phyrexian Invasion and her name and position were inherited by her apprentice.
